text:
Rahul: Spotted a cluster of ownerless admin bindings during the weekend scan. Looks like three service principals and two user accounts with KMS grants but no owner in directory.

Lena: Ugh. Which projects? Can you paste the CSV or gdrive link?

Rahul: Uploaded raw export -> https://drive.redwood/team-security/2026-03-ownerless-admins.csv. Projects: infra-core, analytics-pipeline, payments-staging. Keys with cross-account grants in infra-core.

Priya: For analytics-pipeline I recommend a canary prune on the dev dataset first. We should also add a quick smoke test (auth + job run) post-prune.

Omar: Agreed. Also check CloudAudit for KMS Decrypt events before pruning. If we see Decrypt in last 7d, escalate to owner outreach instead of prune.

Rahul: Quick sample query I ran: 
```
# findings
principal, role, last_auth, project, kms_key
svc-analytics@redwood, admin, 2025-10-04, analytics-pipeline, projects/.../keys/ka1
user.jdoe@redwood, admin, 2024-06-12, payments-staging, projects/.../keys/kb7
svc-orphan@external, admin, null, infra-core, projects/.../keys/kc3
```

Lena: That svc-orphan@external is probably a partner integration. We must not cut it without a coordination window. Tagging @Priya for outreach.

Priya: I'll own owner outreach for analytics and infra. Drafting email template now. Also note retention gap for admin-change logs; compliance needs evidence of audit retention for PR.

security-bot: Automated: created ticket SEC-1479 for ownerless-admins triage -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-1479 :rotating_light:

Omar: To limit blast radius, propose: (1) whitelist critical apps (payments, auth), (2) schedule 8pm-10pm PT prune windows for non-critical clusters, (3) 72h owner notice + canary dev run.

Rahul: I'll prepare an iam-diff patch and include a restore artifact (previous state json) so we can reapply quickly. Command we'll use for restore: 
```
redwood-iam restore --from /tmp/backup-1760019999.json --apply --dry-run
```

Lena: Who's on-call during the first prune? Ops team handled last time. @ops-oncall can you confirm standby?

ops-oncall: Standby confirmed for 2026-03-28 03:00 UTC prune window. Will monitor logs and paging for 6 hours.

Priya: Adding a small QA harness: run smoke tests (auth, read-only query, encrypt/decrypt roundtrip) and then run a sample pipeline job. If smoke fails, automatic restore.

Omar: Also add a rule: if CloudAudit shows any KMS Decrypt by the principal within 7d, mark as DO NOT TOUCH and escalate to sec-review.

Rahul: Found two admin users with last_auth > 365d. I propose we convert those to view-only and notify for 14d before further deletion. Lower risk.

Lena: Good plan. Please include role-change PR with clear rollback steps and link to audit evidence in the PR description.

security-bot: Reminder scheduled: owner-outreach followup -> in 48 hours.

Priya: Will post owner outreach draft in this thread and tag owners once reviewed. Also will attach CloudAudit snippets and KMS key policy diffs.

Rahul: One last note: KMS policies with external principals require CISO approval if the principal is not in our org. Flagged two such keys in infra-core.

Lena: Ok. Let's keep the change-batches small (<=10 bindings) and sequential. Post the first batch list here before any changes.

Omar: Adding runbook checklist to the ticket: pre-checks, notify, snapshot, apply, smoke, monitor, restore-if-fail, post-mortem.

Priya: Thanks. I'll drop the outreach email and whitelist matrix by EOD.

Rahul: Uploaded restore artifacts and the initial canary batch in the ticket. Will run the staging dry-run tomorrow.

Lena: Excellent. We'll reconvene after the staging dry-run and decide go/no-go for prod. :thumbsup:
